title: The Celestial Timeline
subtitle: A chronology of the Enochian transmissions

events.title: John Dee Born
events.description: Born in Tower Ward, London. Son of Rowland Dee, a gentleman server at the court of Henry VIII.

events.title: Dee Enters Cambridge
events.description: Enters St. John's College, Cambridge at age 15. Studies mathematics, astronomy, Greek, Latin, philosophy.

events.title: Dee Studies at Louvain
events.description: Travels to the University of Louvain. Studies with Gemma Frisius and Gerard Mercator. Acquires reputation across Europe.

events.title: Monas Hieroglyphica Published
events.description: Dee publishes Monas Hieroglyphica in Antwerp — a dense symbolic treatise attempting to unify all knowledge through a single glyph.

events.title: First Angelic Actions Begin
events.description: Dee begins scrying sessions, initially with Barnabas Saul as medium. Records the first 'actions' in his spiritual diaries.

events.title: Edward Kelley Arrives at Mortlake
events.description: Kelley (initially calling himself Edward Talbot) presents himself at Dee's Mortlake house. The partnership that produces the Enochian system begins.

events.title: Mystical Heptarchy Received
events.description: The septenary system of planetary kings and princes is transmitted. Dee records the Heptarchical system in his working papers.

events.title: Enochian Alphabet Received
events.description: The 21-letter alphabet of the Angelical language is transmitted to Kelley, along with initial vocabulary.

events.title: Dee and Kelley Depart England
events.description: Dee, Kelley, and their families leave England for the continent, traveling to Kraków at the invitation of the Polish nobleman Albert Łaski.

events.title: The 19 Angelic Calls Received in Kraków
events.description: The Angelic Keys are transmitted. Received in reverse order: Call 19 first, Call 1 last.

events.title: The Cross-Matching Incident
events.description: The angel Madimi instructs Dee and Kelley to share their wives. The incident severely strains the partnership.

events.title: Great Table Corrected by Raphael
events.description: The angel Raphael transmits a corrected version of the Great Table, replacing the 1583 original.

events.title: Dee Returns to England
events.description: After six years abroad, Dee returns to England. His Mortlake library has been vandalized and looted.

events.title: John Dee Dies
events.description: Dee dies in poverty at Mortlake, aged 81. His manuscripts pass through various hands before reaching the British Library.

events.title: A True and Faithful Relation Published
events.description: Méric Casaubon publishes Dee's spiritual diaries — intending to discredit Dee.
